solutions.solution: import java.util.Map; import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap; public class ThreadResourceManager { // Thread storage map private final Map threadMap = new ConcurrentHashMap<>(); /** * Creates a daemon thread with the specified name and task. * * @param threadName the name of the thread * @param task the runnable task to execute * @return true if the thread was created and started successfully; false if * threadName or task is null */ public boolean createDaemonThread(String threadName, Runnable task) { if (threadName == null || task == null) { return false; } Thread thread = new Thread(task, threadName); thread.setDaemon(true); thread.start(); threadMap.put(threadName, thread); return true; } /** * Retrieves a thread by its name. * * @param threadName the name of the thread * @return the Thread instance, or null if not found */ public Thread getThread(String threadName) { return threadMap.get(threadName); } /** * Stops all managed threads by interrupting them. */ public void stopAll() { for (Thread t : threadMap.values()) { t.interrupt(); } } }
